about.title: About — Claira Slate
about.description: Claira Slate started in 2024 as a weekend fix for a broken merge tool. Today it processes millions of documents a month.
about.heroTitle: We make document work boring again.
about.heroSubhead: Claira Slate started in 2024 as a weekend fix for a broken merge tool. Today it processes millions of documents a month for people who never want to think about PDFs at all.
about.value1Body: No signup wall, no email gate, no watermark held hostage. The tool works, then you decide.
about.value2Body: Encrypted in transit, isolated in processing, deleted within the hour. Never used to train a model.
about.value3Body: Every AI response cites its page. If we cannot show you where it came from, we do not ship it.
about.trust1Body: We collect the minimum needed to run the service, and we never sell it. Plain-language policy, no dark patterns.
about.trust2Body: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, isolated processing containers, annual third-party pen test.
about.trust3Body: EU data residency, DPA on request, one-hour retention by default and custom windows on Business.
about.hiringTitle: We are hiring quiet, careful builders.
about.hiringBody: Remote-first across Europe. Three open roles in infrastructure and design.
